in_marathi.name: Malvika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lovely, soft, or gentle
in_marathi.long_meaning: Malvika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘malati’, meaning ‘garland, fragrant flower’. In Hindu mythology, Malvika is the name of a beautiful apsara, or celestial being, often depicted as adorned with flowers.
